title: Sequential-bootstrap LightGBM — avg_uniqueness sample weights
reference: López de Prado AFML Chapter 4 — Sample Weights
motivation: Triple-barrier labels with hold_bars=12 overlap 11/12 bars with neighbours — labels are NOT iid. LightGBM stock bagging memorises co-dependent structure and produces optimistic OOF metrics. Replacing bagging_fraction with avg_uniqueness × balanced_class_weight forces gradient updates to focus on high-uniqueness (low-overlap) samples, yielding more honest OOF estimates.

implementation.change_summary: bagging_fraction + bagging_freq removed from all three trainers; sample_weight = avg_uniqueness(n, HOLD_BARS) * balanced_class_weight passed to lgb.Dataset

b3_primary.note: OOF acc unchanged vs C2-era B3 (0.3857 vs 0.3857) — weighting is more honest, not more optimistic

c1_global_metalabel.note: AUC 0.9078 vs 0.9063 pre-D1 (+0.0015) — marginal improvement; high AUC sustained under honest weighting

CRYPTO.note: AUC 0.9005 vs 0.9124 pre-D1 (-0.0119) — expected: uniqueness weighting is more conservative for small 2-symbol teams; still PROMOTE

COMMODITIES.note: AUC 0.9047 vs 0.9199 pre-D1 (-0.0152) — expected: more honest estimate for small team; still PROMOTE

interpretation.auc_changes_vs_c2: METALS +0.6pp, FOREX +0.4pp, CRYPTO -1.2pp, COMMODITIES -1.5pp. Small-team decreases (CRYPTO/COMMODITIES) are expected: uniqueness weighting is more conservative when label windows overlap heavily in a small pool. Larger teams (FOREX 28k rows) actually improved because uniqueness weighting reduces the false-precision inflation from overlapping labels.
interpretation.conclusion: All 5 models PROMOTE. D1 weighting gives more honest OOF estimates. The -1 to -1.5pp drop on small teams is the point — it removes the optimistic bias, not actual signal.
interpretation.activation_unchanged: Gate flags (metalabel_enabled, metalabel_perteam_enabled) remain False by default. No brain restart required for D1 unless gates are also being turned on.

next_phases: Phase D2: Fractional-diff (d≈0.4) + Hurst exponent features — retrain after 1-2 weeks live data
Phase D3: DXY/VIX/US10Y macro features H1-aligned
Phase E1: HMM-gated experts — only after D1-D3 deliver a deployable Sharpe
